_contrast: WCAG ratios measured with the standard relative-luminance formula. Body text is always cocoa on cream, meadow, or a light tint (all above 4.5:1). White text only appears bold at 18px or larger (AA large, 3:1) or with a cocoa outline (stat numbers).

colours.name: meadow
colours.use: Page background, with soft rounded hills and polka dots in lighter and darker tints.

colours.name: cream
colours.use: Card faces, panels, button faces for secondary buttons.

colours.name: cocoa
colours.use: Ink: all body text, outlines on stat numbers, the soft drop shadows (at 25-35% alpha).

colours.name: moss
colours.use: Primary action (End turn, Play), positive changes (+Attack, won).

colours.name: butter
colours.use: Gold coins, Tier-up button, tier stars. Also the Hive tribe accent.

colours.name: strawberry
colours.use: Health hearts, damage numbers, losses, player health in the lobby.
colours.text_on_it: white bold 3.70:1 (AA large); numbers carry a cocoa outline

colours.name: tangerine
colours.use: Attack badges. Light tint for the Hedgerow folk chip.
colours.text_on_it: cocoa 5.20:1; numbers are white with a cocoa outline

colours.name: berry

colours.name: honey

dark_use: Not a dark-first direction. A dusk variant swaps meadow for #2B3A4A and cream panels for #FFF1DC, keeping every saturated accent; cocoa stays the text colour on panels.
